titulo_video: THE HEIR'S AWAKENING: TENSION AT THE LIMIT!

locucoes.text: Picture the mess Joo Inhyuk got himself into; our protagonist is dealing with powers and desires he doesn't even understand when suddenly an impact noise echoes through the place.
With the crash, someone there gets startled for real and is in total shock at what they just saw or heard.
Right after, the camera shows Joo Inhyuk and Noh Yeseul in a super intimate moment in the kitchen, pressed up against each other.
But suddenly the mood darkens and we're left not knowing what's going on for a second.
In that silence, one of them signals with a finger, because apparently they don't want to get caught in the act.
Check out this close-up on the eye; you can see the person is focused on every detail of the environment.
Then the scene focuses on feet slipping into sandals, showing someone is approaching or trying to sneak out.
The mood gets kind of abstract with these blue tones, signaling that the tension is rising for real.
Meanwhile, our boy is standing with his back to a closed door, seriously thinking whether he should go in.
He finally works up the courage and throws open the passage all at once.
I'M HERE!
On the other side, she gets the shock of her life right when he opens it.
W-WHAT IS IT?
TA-DA-
But then Noh Yeseul breaks into a huge smile and shows the shopping bag, all proud of what she brought for dinner.
She starts talking to the guy there at the door, showing she's all excited about the surprise visit.
YES.
THAT'S RIGHT.
She looks deep into his eyes and makes an invitation that leaves Joo Inhyuk kind of flustered.
RIGHT.
But right then his eye widens; the dude had a real reality shock now.
The heat rises and bodies press together to the point you can see the heart beating in the chest.
The physical closeness reaches a level there's no going back from, raising the tension to the max.
His pupil dilates and his heart races so hard it seems like it'll jump out of his mouth, man.
IF WE MEET ANOTHER TIME.
Noh Yeseul also gets startled because she didn't expect him to react with such intensity all of a sudden.
Then she starts taking off her clothes real slow, with all the caution in the world so the mood doesn't break.
AFTER COMING ALL THE WAY HERE..
Her breathing gets heavy and the mood in the room becomes thick in a way you can already imagine.
Then a rhythmic movement starts; the romantic vibe gave way to something way more intense.
But suddenly someone appears at the door and catches exactly what's happening in there.
MASTER...?
The shock paralyzes his thoughts in the face of that completely unexpected presence.
Our boy freezes completely; he doesn't know whether to run or try to explain the situation to her.
She stares right at him and asks what's going on, wanting to understand this whole mess.
The girl is red as a pepper since he's so close, almost touching her.
This absurd closeness makes her heart race uncontrollably now.
I WAS ALMOST GIVING IN, BUT... I HELD BACK.
No... can't... like this...
The scene continues intense and things are getting more and more out of control for the couple.
Then the two hug each other so tight it seems like the world outside doesn't even exist anymore.
Nugh?!
He lets out a sound of surprise when she makes a move he wasn't expecting at all.
Joo Inhyuk's gaze focuses again; he decided he won't run from this feeling anymore.
NOW YOU'RE GOING TO BE...
Ngh-
Aangh... Haa... AND MY LIBIDO...
Aangh... Hngh!!
WILL FACE THOSE TWO.
The guy smiles and grabs her shoulders, showing that now he's the one in command of the situation.
He squeezes her hard; things are catching fire and nobody can stop anymore.
Suddenly the girl collapses on the floor, as if she'd spent all the energy she had.
Her body gives in completely to the extreme exhaustion after this big whirlwind.
The tension in the room stays insane while the two try to catch their breath after everything.
But a sudden jolt breaks the silence and changes the course of things.
Our protagonist looks down and sees she's still processing what happened.
The camera focuses on her dark hair while she stays there quiet trying to pull herself together.
Joo Inhyuk gives a little smirk; looks like he really enjoyed the result.
Noh Yeseul has wide eyes and her face is on fire, with her heart still racing.
Her lips are slightly parted; she tries to say something but her voice just won't come out.
Then one of them walks toward the back room, seeking a bit of privacy.
The scene gets intense again and the mood of desire takes over everything once more.
However, hesitation appears when the answer finally comes out trembling.
They keep going back and forth, seeming like the night is just getting started for these two.
The impact of the revelation leaves both without reaction for a few seconds.
Physical contact becomes the focus again and we realize the chemistry between them is real.
I ALSO... DIDN'T THINK IT WAS BAD.
A sound effect appears on screen showing things are heating up again, oh my god.
The intensity only increases and the two seem to be in another world now.
Check out his expression; the guy is focused on giving his best at this moment.
Then he holds her head firmly, and she's left not understanding anything with this move.
Joo Inhyuk leans forward and the action around them gets all shaky, man.
It's a moment of pure impact and it seems she's totally giving in to his desires.
Noh Yeseul goes into shock; her eyes don't deny the situation is extreme.
The sound gets muffled while physical contact dominates everything, and her reaction is pure tension.
He goes all in; our boy is definitely not playing around today.
Hmph!
Uungh!
They sync up in a wild rhythm, in an interaction nobody expected this soon.
Nngh
She's even having trouble breathing from so much emotion; the situation totally got out of hand.
The air runs short in their lungs while emotion overflows without any brake.
The girl starts to cry, but it's not from sadness; she's just too emotional to respond.
The demand for an immediate answer tightens the situation between them even more.
He asks what she's feeling while she seems almost suffocated with all this.
싱긋 (smile)
He then firmly holds her face to fix his gaze and get an answer.
푹 (impact) 웩 (reaction)
Hmph!
Nngh
Outside the building is silent, but the sound balloons show inside is a party.
The room 601 sign ends up being the only witness to what these two are up to.
Even the beer can is all crushed there in the corner; the vibe was rough apparently.
The guy gives that mission accomplished smile while satisfaction sounds continue in the background.
Sound effects everywhere; this chapter is delivering everything fans wanted.
The scene continues at the peak of intensity, giving no break to our heartbeats.
MY...
Hmph
I'M GONNA CUM!!
Nnnngh!!
They reach the absolute limit of action, hitting the climax of all this built-up tension.
The movement doesn't stop; they're given over to each other body and soul now.
Libido
After all this chaos, Noh Yeseul only lets out an 'Aangh', leaving doubt whether she can handle the pressure.
